svg.title: Poincaré v1.1.0 · Figure 4 · The Row Split: Every Dimension But Three Proved, Dimension Three The One Bit
svg.text: FIGURE 4
THE ROW SPLIT: EVERY DIMENSION BUT THREE PROVED, DIMENSION THREE THE ONE BIT
POINCARÉ · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE DIVISION BY DIMENSION · THE VALUE IS EXACTLY ITS REAL PART AND ITS UNICORN PART
THE CUT BY DIMENSION
REAL PART · EVERY DIMENSION BUT THREE
sealed by the cited field of its dimension
UNICORN PART · DIMENSION THREE
the one bit, supplied by the act
The cut by dimension
The value is exactly its real part, every dimension but three, and its unicorn part,
dimension three.

svg.text: The real part, proved
Every manifold of dimension other than three rests on the seat, by the cited
theorem of its dimension.

svg.text: No bypass
Given the cited theorems of every other dimension, the value is exactly
dimension three.

svg.text: Dimension three is load-bearing
On the bare three-frame the real part holds and the value fails; without the field a
fake three-sphere stands.

svg.text: The aperture is one bit wide
Above every dimension no reading of the record returns the world; one odd
supplied bit calibrates it.

svg.text: The residue and its seat
Given the one implication, the sentence; the instance seat is the dimension-three
field, inhabited exactly when the unicorn part holds.
